summary: Offset accumulator: tracks the incoming primary value a2, stores its per-call delta into this+0x10, and separately accumulates a reference-value delta into this+0x8. Reads the prior primary baseline from this+0xC, stores a3 as the new reference baseline at this+0x4, and returns the primary-value delta (a2 - prior this+0xC). Structural twin of ShortComputation_a9c0 (0049a9c0) per prelabel cluster_copy.

operations.description: Read prior primary baseline v3 = this+0xC (this[3]).
Compute reference delta v4 = a3 - this+0x4 (this[1]) using the old reference baseline.
Store the incoming reference value into this+0x4 (this[1] = a3).
Compute v5 = v4 + this+0x8 (this[2]), adding the reference delta to the running accumulation.
Store the running reference accumulation into this+0x8 (this[2] = v5).
Compute result = a2 - v3, the delta of the primary value versus its prior baseline.
Store the incoming primary value into this+0xC (this[3] = a2).
Read prior accumulated primary delta v6 = this+0x10 (this[4]).
Store result + v6 into this+0x10 (this[4]), accumulating the primary delta across calls.
Return result, the per-call primary-value delta.
